thread:
samir: ArgoTech alerted: 12x H100 inbound FRA stuck at customs. Forwarder says commercial invoice missing HS code. Hold until broker clears — ETA 72+ hrs.
elaine: We planned to use 8 for the EU Dedicated rollout on Tue. Can infra pull spares or do we postpone?
kevin: Forwarder options: (A) Reroute to AMS via surface+air ~48-72h, minimal brokerage; (B) Air-divert to FRA ~24h but ~+$16.5k expedite/broker fees. Orig AWB: `AWB-ARGO-9001`. Tracking preview: https://track.carrier/ARGO-9001
kevin: Forwarder needs signed split instruction to reroute.
samir: vendor-bot, are these new units or RMA returns? any RMA docs required for customs?
vendor-bot: ArgoTech note: shipment classified as "replacement units" (new, not RMA). No DOA paperwork. Broker flagged missing HS code for GPUs; suggested HS=847330.
anna: Firmware note: EU edge fleet requires H100 fw v1.2. Mixed firmware will complicate rollout. We need 8 matching fw.
elaine: If we can't guarantee firmware parity, we must delay. Can infra accept temporary mixed nodes for non-latency pools?
kevin: Temp pool snapshot: EU spares -> H100 x3, H200 x5, loaners H100 x3 (reserved). So only 3 immediate H100s.
samir: Proposal: pull 5 H100s from the nearest DC (move some test loaners), reroute 8->AMS, hold 4 in FRA for vendor QA. Ask ArgoTech to cover AMS brokerage for that lane; we cover any air-divert if later chosen.
kevin: Forwarder can split 8->AMS and HOLD 4@FRA. They need signed instruction and broker contact. ETA after split ~48h.
vendor-bot: ArgoTech agrees to AMS reroute and will reimburse AMS brokerage if Redwood signs split by EOD. They request consolidated invoice with HS 847330 and our broker listed: EuroBroker BV <ops@eurobroker.example>.
finance-gate: Need written estimate for brokerage and confirm GL code for reimbursement. Ops, can you attach the estimated AMS brokerage?
kevin: AMS lane brokerage estimate = $1,200. Air-divert incremental = $16,500. I'll put numbers in ticket.
anna: We can reassign two non-critical inference clusters to H200s for 24-48h to free up 5 H100s. That plus 3 spares = 8. So rollout can proceed if split happens.
elaine: I'll provisionally delay the rollout by 24h and notify product; final confirm by 15:00 UTC.
kevin: Draft split instruction (signer=redwood):
```
SPLIT_INSTRUCTION:
  ORIGINAL_AWB: AWB-ARGO-9001
  ROUTE_PART1: AMS -> QTY 8
  ROUTE_PART2: FRA HOLD -> QTY 4
  BROKER: EuroBroker BV, ops@eurobroker.example
  HS_CODE: 847330
  SIGNER: Redwood Procurement (samir@redwood.example)
```
kevin: Forwarder ETA after receiving signed instruction: ~48h.
samir: Created ticket INF-2471 to track split, provisioning, and finance reimbursement. If finance signs, we avoid the +$16.5k air charge. :thumbsup:
finance-gate: Approving reimbursement for AMS brokerage $1,200. Please attach invoice reference to INF-2471.
elaine: Great. I'll push the schedule update.
kevin: Sending signed instruction now to forwarder and vendor. Will post new AWBs when split completes.
vendor-bot: Forwarder acknowledged split request. Will push updated tracking when AWBs issued.
